mapper.sql: select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.password, u.sex, u.status, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark, u.manager_num, d.org_num, d.dept_name, d.ancestors, d.parent_id, d.area_code, d.dot_type, pd.dept_name as pa_dept_name, pd.org_num as pa_org_num, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.status as role_status from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_dept pd on d.parent_id = pd.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id
mapper.select:
select distinct u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.nick_name, u.email, u.phonenumber, u.status, u.create_time from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and (r.role_id != #{roleId} or r.role_id IS NULL) and u.user_id not in (select u.user_id from sys_user u inner join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id and ur.role_id = #{roleId})
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{userName}, '%')
AND u.phonenumber like concat('%', #{phonenumber}, '%')
${params.dataScope}
select user_id, user_name from sys_user where user_name = #{userName} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, phonenumber from sys_user where phonenumber = #{phonenumber} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select user_id, email from sys_user where email = #{email} and del_flag = '0' limit 1

select a.user_id,a.user_name,a.nick_name from sys_user a left join sys_dept b on a.dept_id = b.dept_id left join sys_user_role c on a.user_id = c.user_id where a.dept_id = #{deptId} and c.role_id = #{roleId} limit 1

select a.user_id,a.user_name,a.nick_name,a.manager_num,b.dept_id,b.org_num,b.dept_name,b.ancestors from sys_user a left join sys_dept b on a.dept_id = b.dept_id where a.manager_num like concat( #{managerNum},'%')

SELECT u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.manager_num, u.nick_name, u.status, u.del_flag, d.dept_name FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE u.status = '0' AND u.del_flag = '0' AND d.status = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0' AND (
d.dept_id = #{rootDeptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{rootDeptId}, d.ancestors) > 0
)
AND (u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.manager_num LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.nick_name, u.user_id LIMIT 50

select user_id, dept_id, user_name, nick_name, email, avatar, phonenumber, password, sex, status, del_flag, login_ip, login_date, create_by, create_time, remark, manager_num from sys_user where manager_num in
#{managerNum}
select u.user_id from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id where u.del_flag = '0' ${params.dataScope}
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user( user_id, dept_id, user_name, nick_name, email, avatar, phonenumber, sex, password, status, create_by, remark, manager_num, create_time )values( #{userId}, #{deptId}, #{userName}, #{nickName}, #{email}, #{avatar}, #{phonenumber}, #{sex}, #{password}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{managerNum}, sysdate() )

insert into sys_user( dept_id, user_name, nick_name, email, avatar, phonenumber, sex, password, status, create_by, remark, manager_num, create_time )values
( #{u.deptId}, #{u.userName}, #{u.nickName}, #{u.email}, #{u.avatar}, #{u.phonenumber}, #{u.sex}, #{u.password}, #{u.status}, #{u.createBy}, #{u.remark}, #{u.managerNum}, sysdate() )

update sys_user set avatar = #{avatar} where user_name = #{userName}
update sys_user set password = #{password} where user_name = #{userName}
